response.reason: Quantizing query and candidate coordinates to a 1/8 grid introduces per-coordinate delta errors up to 1/8, giving squared-distance noise (~0.1 across the 32 dims) that dwarfs the true differences in distance between candidates (radii differ by only ~0.004, so d[i] differ by ~0.008). The selected winner will essentially be arbitrary among the 16 near-equidistant candidates, so the gathered embedding row will almost certainly be the wrong one, failing the 10% relative tolerance.
